events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album Abbey Road was released in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: More than just an album cover, The Beatles' Abbey Road dropped in '69. Which track still gives you that iconic feeling?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born in 1946, would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Celebrating Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic lead singer Chrissie Hynde, born in 1951, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today. A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, born in 1972, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album Imagine was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Impact
angles.copy: John Lennon's timeless album 'Imagine' was released this week in '71. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod, released this week in '01? It completely changed how we listen to music. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 since Dr. No premiered in '62. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born in 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese, born in 1939, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese. From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped this week in '68. Its experimental sound still sparks debate. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: It marks 35 years since the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His legacy lives on through his music and unforgettable performances.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album Rubber Soul was released in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: This week in '65, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. Which track defines it for you?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: It marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and enduring message of peace continue to resonate globally.
